en-GB.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-GB.subtitle: Discover stories around you
en-GB.description:
The history of where you stand.

Venture reveals the palaces, ships, plaques, buildings and vanished places within a walk of you. Open the app to see nearby stories, hear a concise telling, read the original source, or follow walking directions to the place itself.

DISCOVER WHAT'S NEARBY
See historic places around your current location, ordered by distance and illustrated with photographs where available.

HEAR THE STORY
Listen to short spoken tellings that bring each place to life, then continue into the source material whenever you want the full detail.

FIND YOUR WAY
Use the compass for a quick bearing or view a walking route with distance and time.

BUILD A WALK
Add interesting stops to your walk, reorder them, and play their stories in sequence as a personal local history tour.

EXPLORE WITHOUT LOCATION
Location is optional. Search near a place to explore somewhere else or use Venture without granting location access.

Venture draws on credited historical and geographic sources including Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Historic England, Open Plaques and Geograph. Availability varies by area. Walking directions should be checked against signs and current local conditions.
